question: What are the major service requirements for typical V2X application? [3GPP Release 14]
options: Message transfer latency no longer than 100 ms
Transfer of message size up to 1200 bytes
Support of up to 10 message transfer per second
Communication range sufficient to give driver enough response time
All of the above
correct_answer: All of the above

question: What additional functions does the eNB support in case of SIPTO@LN with collocated L-GW? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Transfer of the collocated S-GW IP address to the EPC
First packet sending and subsequent packet buffering
Support of MME-triggered S-GW relocation
Notification of uplink TEID(s) or GRE key(s) for SIPTO@LN bearer(s)
Activation of SIPTO@LN PDN for requested APN
correct_answer: First packet sending and subsequent packet buffering

question: Which channel is used to transmit the HARQ feedback from a receiver UE to the transmitter UE in NR-V2X (Vehicle to everything)?
options: Physical Sidelink Control Channel (PSCCH)
Physical Sidelink Shared Channel (PSSCH)
Physical Sidelink Broadcast Channel (PSBCH)
Physical Sidelink Feedback Channel (PSFCH)
correct_answer: Physical Sidelink Feedback Channel (PSFCH)

question: What is the purpose of the extended sensors use case in NR-V2X?
options: To provide a holistic view of the environment in each vehicle
To enable vehicles to follow each other closely in a chain
To drive vehicles through a cloud
To share local sensing information with each other
None of the above
correct_answer: To provide a holistic view of the environment in each vehicle

question: What is the purpose of the Last Active USIM? [3GPP Release 18]
options: To provide security features
To store provisioning parameters
To automatically select the active USIM on switch on
To access the IMS services
To update USIM-specific information via the radio interface
correct_answer: To automatically select the active USIM on switch on

question: What does the ZSM framework reference architecture enable? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Construction of more complex management services and functions
Streaming management data over an established connection
Requesting a subscription to receive network events
Authenticating the management service consumer
Establishing a connection for management data streaming
correct_answer: Construction of more complex management services and functions

question: Which of the following analytics subsets is applicable to any consumer? [3GPP Release 18]
options: List of top applications in UL
List of top applications in DL
Both list of top applications in UL and DL
None of the above
correct_answer: Both list of top applications in UL and DL

question: When is the minimum applicable scheduling offset restriction applied? [3GPP Release 17]
options: When the UE is scheduled with DCI format 0_1 or 1_1
When the DCI in slot n indicates an active DL (UL) BWP change
When there is an active DL BWP change in the scheduling cell
When the PDCCH reception includes two PDCCH candidates from two respective search space sets
When the 'Minimum applicable scheduling offset indicator' field is received outside the first three symbols of the slot
correct_answer: When the UE is scheduled with DCI format 0_1 or 1_1

question: How can UE power consumption due to false paging alarms be reduced? [3GPP Release 17]
options: By switching to a target SSSG
By reducing PDCCH monitoring
By relaxing UE measurements for RLM and/or BFD
By providing TRS/CSI-RS occasions to idle/inactive-mode UEs
By dividing UEs into multiple subgroups
correct_answer: By dividing UEs into multiple subgroups

question: What is the purpose of Generic Bootstrapping Architecture (GBA) in 5GC? [3GPP Release 17]
options: To enable application functions to establish shared cryptographic material
To authenticate and authorize user equipment
To provide secure communication between UE and the network
To protect very low throughput MTC devices
correct_answer: To enable application functions to establish shared cryptographic material

question: What is the purpose of the sensing with semi-persistent transmission based mechanism in distributed scheduling (Mode 4)? [3GPP Release 14]
options: To enhance resource separation between transmitters
To estimate future congestion on a resource
To optimize the use of the channel
All of the above
correct_answer: All of the above

question: What does the NWDAF collect from the UPF or the AF related to user data congestion analytics? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Measurement information for the UE location
Input data for the applications being served by AF(s)
Both measurement information for the UE location and input data for the applications being served by AF(s)
None of the above
correct_answer: Both measurement information for the UE location and input data for the applications being served by AF(s)

question: What happens when the Target NF/NF Service triggers the NF/NF Service Context Transfer Pull procedure? [3GPP Release 18]
options: The Target NF/NF Service sends the Context to the Source NF
The Source NF requests the Context from the Target NF/NF Service
The Target NF/NF Service sends a notification to the Old NF about the decommissioning
The Target NF/NF Service receives a response indicating the result of the operation
The Target NF/NF Service sets up the necessary information about the new context location
correct_answer: The Target NF/NF Service receives a response indicating the result of the operation

question: What is the purpose of the Spherical Coverage Grid? [3GPP Release 18]
options: To calculate the CDF of the EIRP/EIS distribution in 3D
To determine the total power radiated by the DUT in the TX beam peak direction
To determine the TX and RX beam peak direction
To perform 3D EIRP scans for TX beam peak direction
To perform 3D Throughput/RSRP/EIS scans for RX beam peak direction
correct_answer: To calculate the CDF of the EIRP/EIS distribution in 3D

question: What is the purpose of the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Information API (Application Programming Interface) specified in GS (Group Specifications) MEC (Multi-access Edge Computing) 028?
options: To provide actual RAN information relating to the User Equipments (UEs) in the network
To estimate the location of vehicles and pedestrians
To trigger user-specific traffic rules on the MEC platform
To reserve networking resources at the host
To emulate the 3GPP mobile access focused RNIS, but for WLAN deployments
correct_answer: To emulate the 3GPP mobile access focused RNIS, but for WLAN deployments

question: What is ProSe Communication? [3GPP Release 17]
options: The process of determining proximity between ProSe-enabled UEs.
The process of establishing new communication paths between ProSe-enabled UEs.
The process of relaying data for multiple ProSe-enabled UEs.
The process of enabling communication between Public Safety ProSe-enabled UEs.
The process of enabling ProSe-assisted WLAN direct communication.
correct_answer: The process of establishing new communication paths between ProSe-enabled UEs.

question: What is the purpose of the Small Data Transmission (SDT) feature in NR? [3GPP Release 17]
options: To enable data transmission in the INACTIVE state for UEs with periodic data packets
To enable data transmission in the RRC_CONNECTED state for UEs with small data packets
To enable data transmission in the RRC_INACTIVE state for UEs with frequent data traffic
To enable data transmission in the RRC_INACTIVE state for UEs with infrequent data traffic
correct_answer: To enable data transmission in the RRC_INACTIVE state for UEs with infrequent data traffic

question: What is the assumption about the scheduling or configuration of the UE for reception of other downlink signals in the DL PRS resource for RTT-based propagation delay compensation? [3GPP Release 17]
options: The UE expects to be scheduled or configured for reception of other downlink channel signals
The UE does not expect to be scheduled or configured for reception of any downlink channel or any other downlink signals
The UE expects to be scheduled or configured for reception of specific downlink signals
The UE expects to be scheduled or configured for reception of downlink signals outside the DL active bandwidth part
None of the above
correct_answer: The UE does not expect to be scheduled or configured for reception of any downlink channel or any other downlink signals

question: Which type of precoding is supported for PSSCH transmission? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Transform precoding
Wideband precoding
Beamforming precoding
Codebook-based precoding
Spatial multiplexing precoding
correct_answer: Wideband precoding

question: How are QoS flows mapped to DRBs in the uplink? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Reflective mapping
Explicit configuration
Both reflective mapping and explicit configuration
Random mapping
correct_answer: Both reflective mapping and explicit configuration

question: What functionality does Signalling Based Activation provide? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Activation of management services for UEs in a specified area
Deactivation of management services for UEs in a specified area
Temporary stop and restart of management services during RAN overload
Request for end user service performance information for one specific UE
Handling management services during handover
correct_answer: Request for end user service performance information for one specific UE

question: When does authentication (charging/billing network) occur in order to get access to services? [3GPP Release 18]
options: For all types of calls
For emergency calls
For CS calls
For PS calls
For both CS and PS calls
correct_answer: For all types of calls

question: Which connectivity model requires URSP rules for steering the mapping between UE applications and PDU Sessions? [3GPP Release 18]
options: Distributed Anchor Point
Session Breakout
Multiple PDU Sessions
All of the above

question: What is one of the functionalities introduced by the Media Handling Extensions for 5G Conversational Services work item? [3GPP Release 16]
options: To introduce support for delay tolerant content delivery and video transmission optimization
To enhance the LTE system for efficient delivery of streaming services
To enhance the framework for live uplink streaming
To specify the media streaming architecture for 5G
To specify the enhancements to enable conformance testing for non bit-exact floating-point implementations of the EVS codec
correct_answer: To introduce support for delay tolerant content delivery and video transmission optimization

question: What are the enhancements for idle/inactive-mode UE power saving in NR? [3GPP Release 17]
options: Enhanced search space set group (SSSG) switching
Provision of potential TRS/CSI-RS occasion(s) to idle/inactive-mode UEs
Relaxation of UE measurements for RLM and/or BFD
Paging enhancements to reduce UE reception power consumption
PDCCH skipping mechanism
correct_answer: Paging enhancements to reduce UE reception power consumption
